audit.rules: high_contradicts (another call's result of the other class; beside a pointer a non-address number, a load through the pointer, a sum of integers) and a returned result beside a returned non-address number; only statements the variable's type carries; functions up to AUDIT_MAX_OPS = 1000 live p-code ops
audit.history: v1 audited every statement and also votes a later pass refused: fmt -O2 +76% (quotearg_buffer_restyled redone for no change), bash -O2 +55% (218 redos, 51.6 s); narrowed to the above; the 2,000-op cap still let a 1,992-op dpkg-divert function cost 10% of its run, so the cap is 1,000

stale_statements: A callee decompiled again after its callers (calleevote redo, convergence sweep) records again; callers decompiled before keep the statement they read. A redo the run discards (arity moved, or failed) restores the earlier statement (kuna_callrettype::restore), so the record describes the printed body.
